evals.prompt: Design a reflection loop for my code-generation agent that retries until an LLM judge scores the output above 0.85.
evals.expected_behavior: Defines an evaluator-optimizer loop with explicit criteria, structured scores, a convergence check, logging, and a bounded iteration budget.
assertions: Separates generation, evaluation, critique, and refinement steps
Sets a max_iterations bound and convergence condition
Requires structured evaluation output and logs each iteration

evals.prompt: Review this completed PR diff once and list the implementation issues; do not propose an iterative evaluator.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes a one-shot implementation review away from agentic-eval rather than inventing an evaluation loop.
assertions: Does not design a reflection or evaluator-optimizer loop
Routes to implementation-review for the one-shot PR review
